data.title: Follow the Arknights: Endfield official social media accounts to earn up to 180 Oroberyls
data.brief: Welcome to Talos-II, Endministrators! The Official Social Media Accounts page for Arknights: Endfiel
data.data:
Welcome to Talos-II, Endministrators! The Official Social Media Accounts page for Arknights: Endfield is now live!


Follow our official socials to earn up to 180 Oroberyls!


Click to join the event https://endfield.gryphline.com/activity/social-media


Or participate in the event in-game: Enter the game and open [Protosync] in the top-right corner > select the triangle icon and choose [News] > [Official Social Media Accounts]. Follow a single official account to receive 60 Oroberyls. Follow more accounts to earn up to 180 Oroberyls!


Stay tuned for first-hand intel on Talos-II, and join our community events to win in-game rewards, exclusive merch, and more!
